newsitem.title: USA: Lucent buys Massachusettes data-switching co.
newsitem.headline: Lucent buys Massachusettes data-switching co.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said it is buying Agile Networks, a privately held Massachusettes data switching firm, for undisclosed terms.
The 60-person firm was founded in 1991 and offers technology that essentially helps computer networks route data.
After the acquisition, Lucent will offer Agile technology to its customers and also integrate the technology into its products, said Lucent spokeswoman Jane Moulton.
Agile will become part of Lucent's Business Communications System unit, Lucent said.
Lucent will also offer and incorporate Agile's software technology helping businesses to manage computer networks, known as "virtual LAN" software, Moulton said.
